import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

def run_campaign(campaign):

    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "V", "kind": "void"},
]
mod = {"name": "m", "params": [["state", "State"], ["message", "Msg"], ["n", "N"]],

     "requires": ["ne", ["var", "p"], ["const", "N", 5]]}

]

           "state_param": "state", "message_param": "message", "transitions": transitions}

def ms(s):
    return [ord(c) for c in s.ljust(2, '\x00')]
def mk(state_idx, msg, n, flagv):
    seq = [("x0", le(state_idx, 4)), ("x2", le(ms(msg)[0], 1)), ("x3", le(ms(msg)[1], 1)),
           ("x4", le(n, 1)), ("x5", le(flagv, 1))]
    return {"entry": "m", "ktest": b64(ktest(seq))}

    mk(0, "a", 3, 0),   # DUP case 0 again
